concept.literalSynthesis: A compact, two-handed jester's musket that spends fallen stars as ammunition, sending a bright star round on a falling arc; a round that hits an enemy releases a smaller star that slowly homes onward.
concept.coreMechanic: Fire one authored ranged projectile per use and consume one selected fallen star through native weapon-ammo handling. The round travels toward the cursor with a downward gravity arc and can hit once; on an NPC hit it spawns one separate, low-damage star that slowly homes toward a nearby NPC. The musket retains the source weapon's 31 base damage, 5.25 knockback, 0.533-second use interval and single-shot cadence. Each shot therefore spends a scarce ammunition item for a conditional follow-up hit; the child does not consume another star. The source weapon's 32-tick interval is retained, while the ammunition source's 17-tick use time is not treated as an attack cadence. Both parents report Blue rarity, but neither establishes an acquisition tier.
concept.parentAContribution: The Jester's Star Musket supplies the literal musket identity and the purposeful ranged, cursor-aimed shot. Its observed ranged damage (31), knockback (5.25), 32-tick use interval, Blue rarity, and 9-pixel-per-tick shot speed ground the authored weapon's pace and initial velocity.
concept.parentBContribution: Fallen Star supplies the literal star-round identity and the actual fallen-star ammo category, so each primary shot uses native ammo selection and conservation. Its source ammo flag establishes that category; its negative item damage is not treated as standalone weapon power.
concept.playerExperience: Aim and fire deliberate single shots. Each accepted shot consumes a fallen star; a successful NPC hit adds one modest homing follow-up. The round's arc makes aim and distance matter, while the secondary hit is conditional rather than guaranteed.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Aim the musket toward the cursor and fire one gravity-arched star round, consuming selected fallen-star ammunition; an NPC hit releases one modest homing star.
When the main round damages an NPC, spawn one separate child star that slowly homes toward a nearby valid NPC; it uses its own low damage and does not spend more ammunition.

realization.description: Fire the Jester's Falling Star Musket with primary use to launch one cursor-aimed round at 33.75 blocks/s. The round bends downward under gravity and can hit once; it dies on solid tile contact or after 3 seconds. Each shot requires and consumes one fallen star selected from inventory. When the round hits an NPC, it creates one separate 7-damage star at the hit location; that star slowly steers toward a valid NPC within 18 blocks, can hit once, and lasts up to 1.5 seconds. The child star does not consume ammunition. The musket has a 0.533-second use interval and does not auto-repeat while held.
